mapper.select: SELECT id, title, content, create_time AS createTime FROM notice ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT id, title, content, create_time AS createTime FROM notice WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notice(title, content, create_time) VALUES(#{title}, #{content}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE notice SET title = #{title}, content = #{content} WHERE id = #{id}
